MEETING NOTES

Date: September 27, 2026

The research team reviewed the new document recognition system.
Every result must include the original input and a clear transcript.
We measure complete page latency, memory use, and character errors.
Faster processing is useful only when the output remains accurate.

Actions for next week:
1. Check English and Chinese documents.
2. Test tables, small print, and unusual page dimensions.
3. Save failures and incomplete outputs with the successful results.
4. Compare identical inputs on the same computer.

Approved by: Research Operations

文档识别测试报告

日期：二零二六年九月二十七日

本报告用于检查中文文档识别的正确性。
每次测试都应保存原始图片和完整识别结果。
性能指标包括处理时间、内存使用量和字符错误率。
提高运行速度的同时，必须保持文字识别准确。

测试要求：
第一，检查标题和正文的阅读顺序。
第二，检查数字、标点符号和表格内容。
第三，不得忽略失败或未完成的测试。
第四，在相同设备上比较相同输入。

负责人：研究团队

WATER QUALITY FIELD REPORT
Station: Willow Creek East     Survey: WC-1186     Date: 28 September 2026

The morning survey covered the upstream bridge and the southern footpath.
Three sealed samples were collected before the first scheduled discharge.
Sample A: 08:15, temperature 18.4 C, pH 7.2, conductivity 412 uS/cm.
Sample B: 08:27, temperature 18.6 C, pH 7.1, conductivity 409 uS/cm.
Sample C: 08:42, temperature 18.5 C, pH 7.3, conductivity 415 uS/cm.

No visible surface film was observed. The water appeared clear at all locations.
Each sample bottle was labelled, photographed, and placed in the transport case.
Laboratory results are pending; these observations are not a safety certification.

Prepared by: Field Operations     Reviewed by: Laboratory Services
